zh.title: 同一个问题，两种回答
zh.corner_tag: 行为示意 · 非实验数据
zh.query: 我会算矩阵乘法，但不知道这一堆乘加在干什么。
zh.badge: router → fuzzy-understanding · 卡点：表征缺失

lines: 矩阵就是按行列排布的数表，
先从定义说起……
乘法规则是行乘列再求和，
我给你展开写一遍……
它满足结合律、左分配律，
单位阵是恒等变换……
来，我们完整算一道 3×3 例题：
矩阵在图形学、机器学习里
应用非常广泛……
接下来讲特征值、SVD 和正交化，
先记住公式……
你算矩阵×向量时，心里把那串
「乘加」理解成什么？
诊断：算法会，缺的是「矩阵 =
线性变换」这层表征——只修这一处。
矩阵 = 对空间的变换；矩阵×向量 =
变换基向量，再按坐标合成。
自测：为什么一般情况下 AB ≠ BA？
用「变换复合」说一句试试。
变式：先旋转再拉伸 vs 先拉伸再旋转，
终点一样吗？换条件还会做才算懂。

zh.tagline: 讲得少一点 · 命中多一点

en.title: One question, two tutors
en.query: I can compute matrix products, but I have no idea what all that multiply-and-add is doing.

lines: A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers —
let me start with the definition…
Multiplication is row-by-column; sum products.
I'll write it out for you…
It's associative, distributive; the identity
matrix acts like the number 1…
Here, let me work a full 3×3 example:
Matrices are everywhere — graphics,
machine learning, physics…
Next: eigenvalues, SVD, orthogonality —
just memorize these formulas…
When you multiply a matrix by a vector,
what do you picture that multiply-add doing?
Diagnosis: algorithm fine; the missing
piece is "matrix = transformation".
A matrix transforms space; M·v = transform
the basis vectors, then recombine.
Self-check: why is AB ≠ BA in general?
Try explaining with "composition".
Variation: rotate-then-stretch vs the reverse —
same endpoint? Transfer proves mastery.
